WITH target_rows AS ( SELECT sb.settle_id, sb.round_no, sb.type, sb.status, sb.total_amount, sb.planned_amount, sb.planned_tax_amount, sb.planned_date, sb.tax_invoice_due_date, sb.trader_name, sb.bank_name, sb.account_number, sb.account_holder, sb.actual_amount, sb.actual_date, sb.created_at, sb.version, st.project_id AS project_id FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id WHERE sb.settle_id IN #{id} AND sb.deleted_at IS NULL ), agg AS ( SELECT st2.project_id AS project_id, sb2.type AS type, SUM(sb2.actual_amount) AS actual_amount_sum FROM settlement_block sb2 JOIN block b2 ON b2.block_id = sb2.block_id JOIN step st2 ON st2.step_id = b2.step_id WHERE sb2.deleted_at IS NULL AND st2.project_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT project_id FROM target_rows) GROUP BY st2.project_id, sb2.type ) SELECT tr.settle_id AS settleId, tr.round_no AS roundNo, tr.type AS type, tr.status AS status, tr.total_amount AS totalAmount, tr.planned_amount AS plannedAmount, tr.planned_tax_amount AS plannedTaxAmount, tr.planned_date AS plannedDate, tr.tax_invoice_due_date AS taxInvoiceDueDate,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tax_invoice ti WHERE ti.settle_block_id = tr.settle_id AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS taxInvoiceLinked, tr.trader_name AS traderName, tr.bank_name AS bankName, tr.account_number AS accountNumber, tr.account_holder AS accountHolder, tr.actual_amount AS actualAmount, tr.actual_date AS actualDate, tr.created_at AS createdAt, tr.version AS version, agg.actual_amount_sum AS actualAmountSum FROM target_rows tr LEFT JOIN agg ON agg.project_id = tr.project_id AND agg.type = tr.type
